status: PROPOSAL for the owner. Nothing is built or scored until the owner copies this file to pr6_ecm33_freeze.json, edits it, sets "frozen": true and commits it (the freeze commit). pr6_ecm33_build.py and pr6_ecm33_report.py refuse a file that is missing or not frozen.
target: ecm33 (KS0086, Q5AGC4, wall slice, leave-clade-out at the fine level)
members: phmmer (one pass, E 1e-5) hits of Q5AGC4 against UniRef50 2025_03, fungal, with a fine clade (pr6_ecm33_members.py); the jackhmmer set is NOT used
extra_calls_note: decision 8: at most 5 unlabelled extra calls per 10,000 proteins; per kept proteome (the precedent rule) and in all: 5 x 32,491 / 10,000 = 16.2455, about 16
labelled_rule: a proteome protein is labelled (not an extra call) when phmmer of Q5AGC4 against that proteome finds it at E <= 1e-5 (the same definition of the family as the members)
hard_negative_rate_note: the hydrophobin precedent value (relaxed.lowest_cutoff(..., 5, 0.05, ...)); proposal: the call rate of any shared hard-negative group (stratum of data/controls/hard-negatives-shared/controls.tsv) may not exceed it
negatives_ignored_note: OWNER DECISION NEEDED. P38248 (S. cerevisiae Ecm33) is a shared hard negative (stratum gpi_wall_enzyme) and is a true member of the family (a custom Ecm33 model should hit it). Proposal: leave it out of the hard-negative rate and report it on its own line. Alternative: keep it as a negative, which pushes the cutoff above the score of a true Ecm33.
min_unit_members_note: a fine clade needs at least 5 members to be a held-out unit (provisional, like the floor of 5 clusters; members are not clusters)

training_rule.note: decision 7, provisional; applied AFTER the independence rule

independence_note: spec 4.4: no training member in the same MMseqs2 cluster (30 percent identity, 50 percent coverage) as a held-out member. For a conserved family this can remove most of the training set; the manifest then says not_buildable. Alternative `none` removes only the held-out members themselves. OWNER DECISION NEEDED.
min_u_note: OWNER DECISION NEEDED. u = held-out members that every comparator misses; a unit is testable when u >= min_u and the custom model must recover at least ceil(u/2) of them (spec 4.6). Lesson of the hydrophobin run: u was 0.

alignment_check.note: PROPOSAL; the stop condition of the build (the hydrophobin cysteine check does not apply to Ecm33); a failing alignment stops the unit and is reported

comparators.pfam_relaxed: PF12454 with a frozen lower cutoff set by the same rule and the same data as the custom model (no positive score)
comparators.iteration: jackhmmer -N 3 --incE 1e-5 -E 1e-5 seeded by the training alignment, searched over the held-out members, the four kept proteomes and the shared negatives

weak_evidence_rows_listed_by_name: Kiss ecm33 (Q5AGC4) is row_verified; the members are homologs by search, not curated Ecm33 (stated in the report)
